remediation: Owner audit AUD-01 / remediation 1 (docs/research/dvp/AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_COMPLETION_REQUIREMENTS.md): generate and archive forecasts before kickoff, evaluate the archived forecasts after the games.
declaredAt: 2026-11-24, before the first 2026 week-12 kickoff (2026-11-26 01:00 UTC) and before any 2026 week-12 forecast was generated (TASK-20261124-006).

frozen.rule: Every file hash in both freezes is verified before each run. The frozen dvp.py is loaded from git at frozen.json's code commit and checked against its hash; the library modules and configs must equal their frozen hashes on disk and be the ones imported. Any mismatch stops the run (BLOCKED).

adapter: arbit-dvp-shadow-v1 (libs/arbit-model/src/arbit_model/dvp/shadow.py): targets from the schedule; the frozen estimator's own steps over them. It reproduces the frozen walk exactly when given the frozen walk's targets (tests and the 2025 rehearsal).

data.history: Seasons 2016-2025: the frozen audit run's observations and schedule (phase1-audit-20261124T024442Z; hashes pinned in config/dvp/frozen.json), with non-touchdown points from the pinned targets index.
data.targetSeason: The forecast season: a fresh build_targets.py of that season alone, into the week's archive, from the nflverse files Arbit holds at forecast time; every object's bytes verified against its digest; observations built with the frozen observations module and admitted through the projection firewall.
data.parameters: Fit by walkforward.fit_fold on every season before the forecast season (2016-2025 for 2026), as the frozen rolling-origin method does.
data.cutoff: pre_first_game_of_nfl_week: the first scheduled kickoff of the target week, from the target-season schedule the build read. Features are rows available by the cutoff (12:00 UTC the day after a game).

readiness: Week W is forecast only when every game of weeks before W has a result in the schedule and FFA lines in the fresh build, and the time is past each such game's availability; otherwise the run waits and retries. A game of an earlier week still without a result 4 days after its kickoff is recorded and does not block.

classification.PROSPECTIVE: Generated and archived before the week's cutoff. Only these enter the prospective evaluation.
classification.MISSED: No forecast archived before the cutoff. Recorded in the ledger as missed; the week is excluded from the prospective evaluation and reported.
classification.RETROSPECTIVE: A forecast reconstructed after the cutoff, stored apart and labeled. Never counted as prospective.
classification.REHEARSAL: A run on a completed season (2025) to prove the harness reproduces the frozen forecasts and that evaluation works. Never counted as prospective.

archive.root: artifacts/dvp/prospective/<season>/ (git-ignored): week-WW/ holds forecasts.parquet, forecasts.csv, manifest.json, league.json and inputs/ (the target-season observations and schedule used, and the fresh targets store).
archive.immutability: A week's directory is created once; files are written to a temporary directory and renamed into place; a second run for an archived week refuses. Files are made read-only.
archive.ledger: ledger.jsonl, append-only, each line carrying the SHA-256 of the line before it and of itself. Every archive, miss and reconstruction appends one line.
archive.export: docs/research/dvp/prospective/<season>/: the ledger and each week's forecasts.csv, manifest.json and league.json, committed and pushed to GitHub before the week's kickoff when possible, for an external timestamp.

evaluation.labels: After the games: a fresh build of the season's targets; observations built the same way. Forecasts join labels by (game_id, offense, position) without dropping any target; label status valid, invalid_* or missing is counted per position and week. Only valid labels enter metrics.
evaluation.phaseB: Frozen protocol over the PROSPECTIVE weeks only: per position, RMSE of every forecast column against B00 on rows with valid labels; week-block bootstrap, 2,000 replicates, seed 1729; practical minimum 1% relative RMSE. D/ST (frozen candidate B06): CONFIRMED if B06 cuts RMSE by at least 1%; NOT_CONFIRMED otherwise. Positions whose frozen candidate is B00: their best DvP variant is reported for information and is never promoted (PROSPECTIVE_2026.md).
evaluation.phaseC: Frozen decisions.py with config/dvp/sitstart.json parameters on the D/ST rows of the PROSPECTIVE weeks as one period: units, pairs, metrics, decide. CONFIRMED needs B06 to clear 1.8 points of pairwise accuracy with net points gained.
evaluation.interim: Until all seven weeks are archived or recorded missed and labeled, results are descriptive and no confirmation label is assigned.
evaluation.missed: Missed weeks are excluded and listed. Retrospective reconstructions are evaluated separately, labeled, and never enter a confirmation.

leagueEvaluation.status: Exploratory and descriptive, declared here before week 12. Not part of the frozen decision rules; no label or promotion rests on it.
leagueEvaluation.capture: At forecast time, read-only: the FFA league's current snapshot (id, observed time, content hash), each FFA team's rostered D/STs and the D/STs on no roster. ESPN team codes map to franchise codes (LAR to LA, WSH to WAS); every D/ST must map to a team in the schedule.

decisions.start: Per FFA team holding two or more D/STs with a game that week: the higher-forecast one, by B00 and by B06.
decisions.stream: Per FFA team: the highest-forecast D/ST among those it holds and those on no roster at the capture, by B00 and by B06.

leagueEvaluation.metric: Per decision where B06 and B00 pick differently: actual FFA points of B06's pick minus B00's; reported as totals, counts and the share where B06's pick scored more (ties 0.5). Picks without a valid label are counted and excluded.
leagueEvaluation.limits: Rosters can change after the capture (waivers, trades); the capture is what a manager could act on at forecast time. Eight teams, seven weeks: few decisions.
